RECORDED FOR L9, NO VERDICT. Full text: org/missions/D9/IRPT/IRPT_BCKEND/deliverables/0.7.0_AE_CloudOps~V/step-4-attempted.result.md blob c62947a9e3e34ccdacd1d7da5934494442e06c85 @58686d5b61, section R64-AC2.
1. WHAT THE LIVE FENCE ADMITS. Source infra/aws/terraform/shared-infra/s3-lgic-firm-buckets.tf:142-171 @4ee8426c72: one statement, Effect Deny, Principal *, Action s3:*, on the bucket and its objects, with Condition ArnNotLike aws:PrincipalArn = concat(fence_patterns[firm], fence_exemption_arns[bucket]) (:158-164 @4ee8426c72). At the 2026-09-18 apply the exemption list was empty (rows W3-S43/S45), so only principals matching the firm's role pattern escape the Deny. Every other IAM principal (users, other roles, administrator identities) meets an explicit deny, which overrides any Allow. The two denials this run say 'with an explicit deny in a resource-based policy', so the refusal came from the bucket policy, not from a missing IAM grant. The live policy bytes were not read: get-bucket-policy is inside the same Deny and outside the issuer's command set.
2. WHY ROOT ALONE GETS THROUGH. The owner account's root user can get, put and delete a bucket policy even when that policy denies it; S3 keeps this as a lockout-recovery path. A Principal * Deny therefore binds every IAM identity and never the recovery path, so only the console or root credentials (held by no seat) can remove the fence.
3. PROPOSAL for 1.0.0_SA_CTO / 4.0.0_SA_CRO, not built: a break-glass exemption present from birth. Either (i) a registry contract rule that every fence's exemption set is non-empty from its first row and always carries one named Opal operator identity, never a firm principal; or (ii) an apply-time precondition that refuses a bucket policy whose ArnNotLike set does not match the applying caller. (ii) also covers a later edit that shrinks the set.
4. NOT TRIED. The account root (no seat holds it; adding root to any list is excluded by Andrew's word); a role assumption needing a new grant (out of scope); other local profiles (the box has one, [default]); credentials on other devices or fabrics (not held by this seat); the console (Andrew is remote).
